svg.title: Census transform
svg.desc: A machine-written census page of enwik9 (Pleasant Lake, Minnesota) before and after the census transform: the page keeps a stub with its deviating text and names, the values go into a record of the census metadata block, and the template texts stand once in the census pseudo article; bars compare the stream bytes of all census pages in 1.0 and 2.0.
svg.text: Census transform
36,148 pages on US places (census 2000) follow a template form. Example: page 203,109 of the stream.

svg.text: three of the variants of the census pseudo article;
# value, @ name, $ state
Values: per place type an online ridge regression over
the values coded before, an offset per state and the
mean of the 8 nearest earlier places give the estimate.
Rules cover exact relations, such as the 504 people of the
census sentence, the population of the first sentence again.
The encoder checks every automatic unit byte by byte.
